propertySets.name: Pset_BerthCommon
propertySets.definition: properties common to the definition of all occurrences of IfcSpace and types of IfcSpaceType with the predefined type set to BERTH

properties.name: BerthApproach
properties.definition: How the vessel approaches the berth

properties.name: BerthMode
properties.definition: Orientation of vessel as it approaches berth

properties.name: BerthingAngle
properties.definition: Angle of approach for the vessel to the berth

properties.name: BerthingVelocity
properties.definition: Velocity of the vessel as it berths

propertySets.name: Pset_FenderDesignCriteria
propertySets.definition: Properties common to the definition of design criteria of all occurrences of  IfcImpactProtectionDevice and types of IfcImpactProtectionDeviceType with the predefined type set to FENDER.

properties.name: CoefficientOfFriction
properties.definition: Coefficient of friction value for the fender

properties.name: MaxReactionTolerance
properties.definition: Manufacturing tolerance on maximum reaction at fender support.

properties.name: MaximumTemperatureFactor
properties.definition: Deviation in performance due to maximum design temperature

properties.name: MinimumTemperatureFactor
properties.definition: Deviation in performance due to minimum design temperature

properties.name: VelocityFactorEnergy
properties.definition: Deviation in energy absorption performance due to strain rate

properties.name: VelocityFactorReaction
properties.definition: Deviation in reaction due to strain rate

properties.name: EnergyAbsorption
properties.definition: Energy absorption capacity of the element.

properties.name: MinCompressedFenderHeight
properties.definition: Minimum height required for a compressed fender to prevent vessels striking the structure

properties.name: AddedMassCoefficientMethod
properties.definition: Method used to determine the Added Mass Coefficient used for design
